fields.description: What the coach measures, e.g. Body Fat %, 20m Sprint, Vertical Jump.
fields.label: Metric

fields.description: Only active metrics are offered on a new assessment. Switching one off keeps every reading already recorded.
fields.label: Active

fields.description: The unit every reading of this metric is recorded in, e.g. kg, cm, %, sec, reps. Changing it once readings exist would silently rewrite history, so it is locked at that point.
fields.label: Unit

fields.description: Which way is improvement? A sprint time falls as the athlete improves; a vertical jump rises. This is what lets the progress view show an honest up or down arrow.
fields.label: Improvement Direction
fields.options:
Higher is better
Lower is better

fields.description: Groups the metric on the assessment form and in the progress view.
fields.label: Group

fields.description: Which members this metric is offered for, matched against the member's Category. Sport members get the performance battery; General members get the body-composition check.
fields.label: Applies To

fields.description: Maintained by the app. Height, Weight and BMI are typed into their own fields on an assessment and mirrored into the readings automatically, so the progress view has one uniform series for everything.
fields.label: Built-in
How to Measure
fields.description: Optional protocol note for the coach, e.g. "best of three attempts, standing reach subtracted".
